data.name: Mining Weekly
data.intelligence_type: Weekly SA and African mining news; project developments; commodity price signals; company announcements; infrastructure updates (Transnet, port capacity). Free access to most articles.

data.name: Argus Media
data.intelligence_type: Subscription-based price intelligence for coal (API4/RB FOB), ferrochrome, iron ore, and manganese; freight rates; trade flow analysis; South Africa-specific coal price assessments are industry benchmark (API4 index). Free news summaries available.

data.name: Fastmarkets
data.intelligence_type: Ferrochrome quarterly benchmark price (market-making publication); chrome ore spot assessments; iron ore and manganese price data; South Africa critical minerals policy coverage. Some free insights; full price data requires subscription.

data.name: Mining-Bulletin
data.publisher: Global Minerals and Metals Information Center
data.intelligence_type: Free-access SA chrome ore and manganese ore export price updates; global metals and minerals pricing; particularly useful for monitoring week-on-week SA export price movements for chrome and manganese without a subscription.
